{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Count the number of completed orders
completed_orders = (sales['status'] == 'completed').sum()

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check the number of QA orders and their status
num_qa_orders = len(qa_orders)
qa_status_counts = qa_orders['status'].value_counts()

# Count completed orders excluding QA orders
completed_without_qa = (sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue'] != '999999.99')]).shape[0]

# Print all relevant numbers
print(f"Total completed orders (including QA): {completed_orders}")
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue == '999999.99'): {num_qa_orders}")
print(f"QA orders status distribution:\n{qa_status_counts}")
print(f"Completed orders excluding QA: {completed_without_qa}")"}
